message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta.  
Noise complaints are handled by the **Atlanta Police Department** (APD) and can be reported in several ways:

| Method | How to File | Contact |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| **Online** | Use the city’s 311 portal: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> (select “Noise Complaint” from the list of services). | – |
| **Phone** | Call the APD Noise Complaint Unit at **404‑656‑4000**. | 404‑656‑4000 |
| **Email** | Send a brief description of the issue to **noise@atlantaga.gov**. | noise@atlantaga.gov |
| **In‑person** | Visit the APD headquarters at 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30308, or any local police station. | – |

**What to include in your complaint**

1. Your name and contact information (optional if you prefer anonymity).  
2. Date, time, and location of the noise.  
3. Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).  
4. Any relevant photos or audio recordings (if available).  

**After filing**

- The APD will investigate and may issue a warning or citation if the noise violates city ordinances.  
- If you’re dealing with a recurring problem, you can follow up by calling the same number or emailing the same address.

Feel free to let me know if you need help drafting the email or navigating the online portal!
